About Cedar Ridge Dental

Cedar Ridge Dental has cared for Portland families for more than fifteen years from its office on Cedar Road. The practice was founded on a simple idea: explain the plan, respect the patient's time, and never recommend work that is not needed. Our two dentists and three hygienists see the same families year after year, which is what makes genuinely preventive care possible rather than a series of disconnected emergencies. We invest in digital imaging and same-visit restorations so that most treatment can be finished in-house, and we file insurance directly so patients are not left chasing reimbursement. Above all, we want the first visit to feel unhurried, because trust is built in that first conversation.

Our team

Every clinician on staff is licensed in Oregon and completes continuing education each year in restorative and preventive dentistry.
